_comment: ts-next pack surface map. Path -> surface(s). Consumed by core _factory.surface(). Generic TS/Next/Hono/Prisma topology — tune the rules to your repo's layout. match primitives: contains (substring of leading-slash path), endswith, regex.
_ungoverned_note: node_modules/.next/.turbo/generated are ungoverned anywhere (never source). dist/build/out/coverage are anchored to a package root so a real route like app/build/page.tsx or app/coverage/page.tsx is still reviewed, not silently exempted.
